mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing cycle, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening demand, which increases corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising UNRATE above 7% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and pressures equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising FEDFUNDS above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and pressures equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling UNRATE below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).
